title: SDK Developer – Android
description:
***About the Role***

Most mobile developers spend their careers building apps that sit on top of the platform. Here, you go one layer deeper. You’ll work directly on the SDK that powers Jio’s AI-enabled wearables — the code that bridges a native mobile app to real hardware. It’s a rare opportunity for a mobile developer to get hands-on with device communication, firmware interaction, and platform engineering in a product that’s shipping to real users.

You don’t need SDK experience to join — strong native Android and/or iOS skills are enough. We’ll help you grow into the rest.

***Roles & Responsibilities***

1. Build and maintain features in the Native Android and/or iOS SDK — clean, testable, production-grade code that other teams depend on.
2. Work on the protocol layer connecting the SDK to Jio AI enabled wearables — a close collaboration between software and hardware.
3. Write unit and integration tests; contribute to CI/CD pipelines and release verification.
4. Debug issues that span multiple layers — app, SDK, and device — and contribute to root-cause analysis.
5. Collaborate with Engineering, QA, and Delivery on feature commits, code reviews, and sprint goals.

***Must-Have Skills***

* Strong native Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift) — whichever is your primary platform, that’s your major.
* Openness to picking up the other platform over time as your minor — we pair people deliberately to make this happen.
* Curiosity about how software talks to hardware; Bluetooth protocol experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

***Nice to Have***

* Any exposure to SDKs, shared libraries, or framework development.
* Familiarity with React Native or hardware-paired companion apps.

title: Lead Frontend Engineer
description:
**Description**

* Own end-to-end frontend architecture for AI and Non-AI Platform products, defining patterns for streaming UI, real-time agent responses, tool-call visualization, citations/grounding display, and multi-turn conversational state.
* Define and enforce the frontend technology stack, coding standards, component architecture (design system), and state-management strategy across all AI Platform UI surfaces.
* Architect the integration layer between frontend applications and AI backend services (Vertex AI / Gemini, Google ADK agents, RAG pipelines, LangGraph/LangChain orchestrators) via secure, well-documented APIs (Fast/REST/GraphQL/WebSocket/SSE).
* Drive technical decisions on rendering strategy (SSR/CSR/ISR), edge/streaming delivery, performance budgets, and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) for AI-heavy, latency-sensitive interfaces.
* Design and maintain the AI Platform's internal Developer Portal / Self-Service Console, enabling engineering teams to provision AI resources (RAG pipelines, agents, vector indices, environments) without manual tickets — extending self-service cloud infrastructure provisioning patterns into the UI layer.
* Build and version a reusable AI-UI Component Library / Design System (chat widgets, agent trace viewers, citation cards, feedback/human-in-the-loop widgets, prompt/response inspectors) consumable by multiple product squads across the enterprise as a shared platform capability.
* Define 'golden path' frontend templates and starter kits (Next.js/React + AI SDK boilerplate) so downstream product teams can spin up new AI-powered UIs in days, not weeks — a core platform-engineering productivity outcome.
* Own the frontend layer of platform Service Catalog entries (e.g., 'Conversational Agent UI', 'Document Intelligence Console') including golden-path templates, scorecards, and documentation, aligned to internal developer-platform (IDP) practices.
* Partner with platform/infra teams to expose infrastructure and model-routing configuration (e.g., cost-aware model selection between Gemini Flash/Pro) through simple, safe self-service UI controls rather than backend-only configuration.
* Establish frontend observability (RUM, tracing of AI response latency, token-stream monitoring) integrated with platform-wide SRE/observability tooling leveraging Dynatrace SaaS.
* Build production-grade full-stack features spanning UI, BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) layer, and orchestration services that call LLM/agent backends (Vertex AI Gemini, Google ADK multi-agent workflows).
* Implement secure, low-latency streaming pipelines (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) for token-by-token AI responses, agent 'thinking' states, and tool-execution progress indicators.
* Integrate authentication/authorization (OAuth2 client credentials, API Gateway via Apigee X) into frontend session and API-call flows, ensuring B2B and B2E security compliance.
* Collaborate with backend/platform engineers on API contracts, chunking/retrieval metadata exposure (for citation rendering), guardrail/response-safety signal surfacing, and error/fallback UX for model or agent failures.
* Evaluate and select appropriate technologies and tools to support the development and deployment of products on the eCommerce foundation layer
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements, and translate them into technical and non-functional specifications
* Work with Product teams to understand their pain points and increase the Developer Experience through Platform Engineering Capabilities
* Strategize & work with senior leaders across Ford’s Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations to make significant, measurable impact on the eCommerce Platform
* Experience in Cloud FinOps to optimize Cloud Infrastructure Consumption Cost

**Responsibilities**

* AI-Native Chat & Agent UI: Production conversational interface with streaming responses, multi-agent trace visualization, citation/grounding display, and tool-call transparency, built with React 18+/Next.js (App Router, Server Components/Actions).
* AI SDK Integration Layer: Frontend integration React.js-Node.js (Typescript) / LangChain.js / Google ADK web clients for streaming completions, function-calling UI, and structured output rendering.
* Design System & Component Library: Versioned, themeable component library (Storybook-documented) with AI-specific components — chat bubbles, agent step timelines, feedback thumbs-up/down + RLHF capture widgets, prompt inspector, retrieval-source cards.
* Real-Time & Streaming UX: SSE/WebSocket-based streaming UI patterns, optimistic UI, token-level rendering, and graceful degradation/fallback states for model latency or failure.
* State Management: Robust conversation/session state handling using modern state libraries supporting multi-turn context and agent memory visualization.
* Accessibility & Performance: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, Core Web Vitals-optimized AI UI, with performance budgets for time-to-first token and time-to-interactive.
* Testing Suite: Component (Jest/RTL), E2E (Playwright) test suites including deterministic mocking strategies for non-deterministic LLM outputs.
* Developer Self-Service Portal UI: Internal web console for provisioning AI resources, viewing agent/RAG pipeline health, and managing environment configs, aligned to Cloud Platform self-service provisioning.
* BFF / API Layer: Backend-for-Frontend service (FastAPI / Node.js) mediating between UI and AI backends, handling auth, request shaping, response streaming, and caching.
* Agent & RAG Orchestration Integration: Full-stack wiring to Google ADK multi-agent workflows (intent classification, routing, guardrails) and Vertex AI RAG Engine / Gemini for grounded, cited retrieval-augmented responses.
* Vector Search & Retrieval UI-to-Backend Contract: End-to-end pipeline exposing embeddings/vector search results (BigQuery, Vertex Vector Search) with chunk-level metadata surfaced in the UI for source citation.
* Secure API Gateway Integration: Full-stack OAuth2 (client-credentials) authentication flows through Apigee X / API Gateway, including token refresh, session handling, and role-based UI rendering.
* Cost-Aware Model Routing UI: Full-stack feature exposing dynamic LLM routing (e.g., Gemini Flash vs. Pro) based on query complexity, with a UI toggle/telemetry dashboard for cost and latency visibility.
* Deployment on Kubernetes (GKE): Containerized frontend and BFF services with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Cloud Build), deployed via GKE with progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) and environment promotion aligned to platform standards.
* Observability & Feedback Loop: Full-stack telemetry capturing latency, token usage, guardrail triggers, and user feedback, feeding back into model/prompt evaluation dashboards.
* Reference Architecture & Golden Path Repo: A reusable, documented starter template (frontend + BFF + agent integration) published to the internal platform catalog for rapid onboarding of new AI product teams.
* Platform-as-a-Product mindset: Define and track adoption, developer satisfaction (DevEx/NPS), and time-to-first-deploy metrics for teams consuming the AI UI SDK/component library.
* Service Catalog ownership: Publish and maintain frontend 'golden path' templates as catalog entries (e.g., via Backstage-style internal developer portal) with clear SLAs, ownership, and versioning.
* Self-Service Enablement: Extend self-service cloud infrastructure provisioning into the presentation layer — enabling product teams to self-provision chat UIs, agent consoles, and dashboards without platform-team tickets.
* Reusability & Multi-Tenancy: Architect UI components and BFF services to be multi-tenant and configuration-driven so multiple business units/products can adopt the same platform UI foundation.
* Governance-as-Code: Embed responsible-AI, security, and accessibility guardrails directly into shared components and CI pipelines so consuming teams inherit compliance by default.
* Platform Roadmap & Feedback Loops: Run regular platform reviews with consuming teams to prioritize the AI-UI roadmap, deprecations, and versioning strategy.

description:
**Immediate to 30 days preferred**

**Job Type**

: Long Term

**Experience**
: 7-10 Years

**Work Preference**
: Onsite

**Work Location:**
Pune, MH

**Domain**
- Fire & Safety

**About Job Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Firmware Design Engineer with 7-10 years of experience to develop, enhance, migrate, sustain, and release embedded firmware for fire and life-safety portfolio. The role supports new product development, product extensions, platform modernisation, value engineering, component obsolescence, compliance, and field or production support. The engineer will own assigned firmware work packages, define maintainable architectures, develop reusable platform software and product features, and ensure deterministic behaviour on target hardware. Assignments may include microcontroller or toolchain migration, protocol development, diagnostics, hardware integration, verification, and issue resolution across multiple product families.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Firmware Architecture and Product Development**

• Own firmware work packages for new products, product enhancements, redesigns, sustenance, and value-engineering initiatives.

• Analyses system and software requirements, hardware interfaces, existing code, field behavior, regulatory constraints, and manufacturing needs before defining the implementation approach.

• Define and implement modular architectures covering startup, BSP, HAL, drivers, protocols, application logic, diagnostics, configuration, and production-test support.

• Develop production embedded software in C for bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, with appropriate use of interrupts, timers, state machines, memory, and communication peripherals.

• Plan and execute microcontroller, compiler, IDE, or hardware-platform migrations when required, including build, linker, startup, timing, peripheral, and compatibility changes.

• Create reusable software components and controlled product configurations that reduce duplication and simplify maintenance across product families.

**Real Time Control Interfaces and Diagnostics**

• Implement deterministic control, supervision, communication, indication, relay, power-state, and fault-handling behaviour appropriate to the product.

• Design safe responses for reset, brownout, watchdog, communication loss, open or short circuits, power transitions, and invalid configuration conditions.

• Develop or maintain wired and proprietary communication protocols, diagnostics, logging, calibration, and service functions while preserving required compatibility.

• Manage flash, RAM, stack, CPU loading, timing, and recovery margins and document relevant design limits.

**Software Quality Verification and Compliance**

• Convert system, hardware, regulatory, and product requirements into software requirements, design descriptions, test cases, and traceability.

• Develop unit, integration, hardware-in-the-loop, fault-injection, protocol, timing, and regression tests, including reusable test utilities and automation where practical.

• Apply coding standards, peer review, static analysis, version control, defect tracking, root-cause analysis, and controlled change practices; apply MISRA C principles where appropriate.

• Perform board bring-up and signal-level debugging with hardware engineers using debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial tools, and protocol analysers.

• Support UL, FM, FCC, and other required compliance or certification testing with controlled test firmware, issue reproduction, corrective action, documented evidence, and retest closure.

Product Lifecycle Release and Technical Leadership

• Assess firmware impact from value-engineering changes, alternate components, hardware revisions, and component obsolescence; update drivers, calibration, timing, and configuration as required.

• Release reproducible firmware packages containing source, project files, configuration, binaries, maps, checksums, release notes, test evidence, and traceability.

• Support production programming, ICT or FCT, pilot builds, phase-in, sustaining issues, and structured investigation of field problems.

• Review junior engineers' work, identify dependencies and risks early, and communicate design decisions and verification status in technical reviews.

**Qualifications**

• 7-10 years of hands-on embedded firmware-development experience, including responsibility for implementation, integration, debugging, verification, and production release.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunication, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline.

• Strong Embedded C skills and practical experience with bare-metal or RTOS-based systems, interrupts, timers, state machines, memory constraints, and deterministic real-time behaviour.

• Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining modular BSP, HAL, driver, protocol, application, diagnostic, or boot and update layers for production embedded products.

• Experience migrating firmware between microcontroller families, compilers, IDEs, or hardware revisions and resolving architecture, linker, startup, timing, and peripheral differences.

• Hands-on debugging with embedded toolchains, JTAG or SWD probes, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, serial tools, and protocol analysers.

• Working knowledge of version control, code review, static analysis, defect tracking, configuration management, unit testing, integration testing, and regression testing.

Preferred Experience

• Prior firmware-development experience in fire alarm, fire and life-safety, emergency communication, building-automation, or another regulated product industry is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on participation in UL and FCC compliance or certification programs is strongly preferred; experience supporting UL 864 or FM Approvals is valuable.

• Experience with Renesas or comparable microcontrollers, IAR or similar toolchains, processor migration, or legacy-code modernisation is preferred.

• Experience with fire-alarm communication loops, notification circuits, RS-485 or proprietary networks, supervised field circuits, annunciation, relay control, or networked power products is advantageous.

**Core Competencies**

Ownership Mindset | Embedded C | Firmware Architecture | Product Development | Real-Time Systems | Protocol Engineering | Hardware Debugging | Software Quality | Compliance | Technical Guidance
